Let me reconsider the geometry. The map row 7 is `#.@P....#...#`. So (1,7)='.', (2,7)='@', (3,7)='P'. The notice board is reported at (2,7) but the map shows '@' there, not 'o'. So the notice board might actually be a wall-mounted object at a tile that the map doesn't render as 'o'. 

But the key insight: I can't move in ANY direction. Even into empty tiles. This suggests my body is somehow locked. 

Wait — maybe the issue is that the notice board is at (2,7) and it's a solid object, and I'm overlapping it. The game's collision prevents me from moving because I'm inside a solid. 

Let me try the body_walk_to again now that time has passed — maybe pathing recovers.
